report.title: Monthly Business Performance
report.summary: October closed with record revenue as the new usage-based plan converted well. Costs rose with two engineering hires and a one-off migration, but margin stayed above 60%. Churn held steady and enterprise pipeline grew for the third month in a row.

insights: Usage-based plan accounts for 41% of new sign-ups since launch.
Support tickets per customer fell as the new help center went live.
Two enterprise trials are scheduled to convert in November.
